content.scopeOfRegistration: The scope of the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate covers the information security management system (ISMS) supporting cloud services, data, systems, processes, and people required for the design, development, and deployment of the in-scope Amazon services, in accordance with the statement of applicability, version 1.1, dated May 14, 2025.  The scope is comprised of Amazon Global Logistics, Amazon Warehousing and Distribution, Seller Export and Delivery, Amazon Freight, Amazon Air Cargo, Fulfillment by Amazon inbound services, Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment, and Buy with Prime.

The scope of the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate is limited to the information security management system (ISMS) supporting
the secure handling and protection of OEM information, OEM prototype components and parts, and OEM prototype vehicles
in the in-scope ASV laboratories, in accordance with the statement of applicability, version 1.7 dated March 31, 2025.

The scope of the ISO/IEC ISO 42001:2023 certification is limited to the artificial intelligence management system (AIMS) supporting the AWS Services including: Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q Business, Amazon Transcribe, and Amazon Textract in the role of an AI producer and AI provider, in accordance with the statement of applicability, version 2.0, dated August 25, 2025.

The scope of the ISO 9001:2015 certification is limited to the quality management system (QMS) supporting the testing, validation, security, and associated governance activities supporting the Amazon Business (AB) applications.

The scope of the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification is limited to the information security management system (ISMS) supporting the people, processes, and technologies owned and operated by Amazon Business (AB) that are foundational to provide its products and services, in accordance with the statement of applicability, version 1.0, dated March 12, 2026.

The scope of the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate is limited to the enterprise information security management system (ISMS) supporting the Stores, Devices, and Other (SDO) security operations, the tools and technologies provided by Amazon SDO security for Amazon SDO business teams to adopt, and information repositories that house Amazon SDO security information, in accordance with the statement of applicability, version 6.0, dated December 2, 2025. Amazon SDO comprises non-AWS businesses under the broader Amazon.com Inc. organization. The scope includes assets, technologies, people, and processes provided by Amazon SDO security for the enablement of secure development, operations, and delivery of products and services by Amazon SDO business teams.

The scope of this ISO/IEC 22301:2019 certificate is limited to the business continuity management system (BCMS) supporting Amazon Leo's software and firmware involved in the transit of end user payload data between a Customer Terminal and a Leo Point of Presence, comprising satellite bus and payload stacks; customer terminal software; ground segment software; and software-defined network path management across Leo nodes. Supporting capabilities comprise software build and deployment to satellites, terminals, and gateways, constellation and fleet operations, hardware root-of-trust and encryption, security monitoring and incident response.

The scope of this ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate is limited to the information security management system (ISMS) supporting Amazon Leo's software and firmware involved in the transit of end user payload data between a Customer Terminal and a Leo Point of Presence, comprising satellite bus and payload stacks; customer terminal software; ground segment software; and software-defined network path management across Leo nodes. Supporting capabilities comprise software build and deployment to satellites, terminals, and gateways, constellation and fleet operations, hardware root-of-trust and encryption, security monitoring and incident response, in accordance with the statement of applicability, version 2.0, dated July 31, 2026.
